CODD.Settings.Configuration.Name: Curse Configuration
CODD.Settings.Configuration.Label: Configure victims
CODD.Settings.Configuration.Hint: Choose the victims, their individual activation dates, and the paladin whose Aura of Protection may aid them.
CODD.Settings.SaveDC.Name: Curse saving throw DC
CODD.Settings.SaveDC.Hint: The DC of the saving throw against the attacked ability.
CODD.Settings.PaladinChance.Name: Paladin proximity chance (out of 10)
CODD.Settings.PaladinChance.Hint: The victim is near the paladin when 1d10 is equal to or lower than this value. The default 5 means a 5/10 chance.
CODD.Settings.FallbackAuraBonus.Name: Fallback Aura of Protection bonus
CODD.Settings.FallbackAuraBonus.Hint: Used when the proximity check succeeds but no paladin actor can be found. A configured paladin uses their current Charisma modifier instead.
CODD.Settings.IntervalDays.Name: Days between curse attacks
CODD.Settings.IntervalDays.Hint: How many Simple Calendar days pass between attacks. Changing this resets every victim's next attack date.
CODD.Settings.AbilityLossFormula.Name: Ability score loss
CODD.Settings.AbilityLossFormula.Hint: A roll formula for ability score loss after a failed save, for example 1d4 or 2.
CODD.Settings.RollMode.Name: Curse roll mode
CODD.Settings.RollMode.Hint: Default visibility for player-character curse rolls that do not yet have an individual mode. Each victim can override it in the configuration panel. NPC rolls are always blind GM rolls.
CODD.Settings.SpellHealingPenalty.Name: Spell healing penalty
CODD.Settings.SpellHealingPenalty.Hint: Reduce each applied healing result from a spell by this many HP. Rests and potions are excluded.
CODD.Config.Title: Curse of Death and Despair
CODD.Config.IndividualSchedules: Individual activation date for each victim
CODD.Config.IndividualSchedulesHint: Select a victim and set the day of their first or next attack.
CODD.Config.VictimsHint: Every selected character receives a separate chat card on their own scheduled date. Uncheck a character after their curse is removed.
CODD.Config.NoActors: No character or NPC actors are available.
CODD.Config.PaladinHint: When nearby, the chosen paladin's current Charisma modifier is temporarily added to the curse saving throw. Automatic mode chooses the detected paladin with the highest modifier.
CODD.Config.RemoveEffectsConfirm: Remove the managed ability-drain and next-save advantage effects from the victims currently checked in this window? Their base ability scores will be restored.

CODD.Rules.JournalName: Curse of Death and Despair — Rules
CODD.Rules.Title: Curse of Death and Despair
CODD.Rules.Introduction: This entry is maintained automatically by the module and reflects the curse's current settings.
CODD.Rules.PaladinCheck: First, roll 1d10. A result of {chance} or lower places the victim within the Aura of Protection.
CODD.Rules.PaladinSelfAura: A victim with at least {level} Paladin levels does not make the proximity roll: they automatically receive their own Aura of Protection.
CODD.Rules.AbilityCheck: A 1d6 roll selects the attacked ability: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
CODD.Rules.Save: The victim makes a saving throw using the selected ability against DC {dc}.
CODD.Rules.Failure: On a failure, the curse drains the selected ability using {formula}. The loss is stored as a reversible effect and cannot lower the ability below 0.
CODD.Rules.NaturalOne: A natural 1 on a failed save adds +1 to the ability-loss formula.
CODD.Rules.NaturalTwenty: A natural 20 grants advantage on the next saving throw against the curse; that advantage is then consumed.
CODD.Rules.Healing: Each applied healing result from a spell restores {penalty} fewer HP to a victim, to a minimum of 0 HP restored.
CODD.Rules.HealingExceptions: Short rests, long rests, elixirs, and potions are not affected.
CODD.Rules.Interval: Interval between each victim's attacks: {interval} days.
CODD.Rules.NpcRolls: Every NPC curse check is always a blind GM roll.
CODD.Rules.ChatPermissions: Only the affected victim's owners and GMs can see and use that chat card's buttons.
CODD.Rules.Records: The module keeps a separate editable roll history for every victim. The GM controls which record categories each player may view.
CODD.Rules.NoExactDate: Exact next-attack dates are visible only to GMs in the module configuration.
CODD.Rules.Removal: After the curse is removed, the GM removes the module-managed effects and unchecks the actor from the victim list. Base ability scores are never overwritten.
CODD.QuickAccess.Label: Curse of Death and Despair quick access
CODD.Records.Title: Curse records
CODD.Records.HistoryHint: Every row preserves the rolls, attacked ability, Aura of Protection, outcome, and ability loss from one curse attack.
CODD.Records.DeleteConfirm: Permanently remove this attack from the victim's curse history?
CODD.Records.NoHistory: This victim has no recorded curse attacks yet.
CODD.Records.SharingHint: For each player, choose exactly which categories from this victim's records are visible in their quick-access panel.
CODD.Records.NoVisibleData: No curse data has been shared with you
CODD.Records.NoVisibleDataHint: The GM can grant access to individual victims and selected categories.
CODD.Notifications.MissedCyclesCapped: More than 20 curse cycles were skipped for at least one victim. Only the first 20 were created.
CODD.Notifications.CalendarError: The curse schedule could not be processed. Check the console for details.
CODD.Notifications.InvalidLossFormula: The formula "{formula}" is invalid. The module used 1d4 instead.
CODD.Notifications.SaveCancelled: The saving throw was cancelled. The chat-card button is available again.
CODD.Notifications.ActionError: The curse action failed. Check the console for details.
CODD.Notifications.RecordsSaved: Curse records and player access have been saved.
CODD.Notifications.ScheduleReset: Every victim's curse schedule has been reset from the current calendar day.
CODD.Notifications.NotOwner: Only the victim's owner or a GM can use this button.
CODD.Notifications.WrongSystem: Curse of Death and Despair requires the dnd5e game system.
CODD.Notifications.CalendarMissing: Curse of Death and Despair requires Simple Calendar Reborn to be active.
